text:
Ryan - Sales: kicking off pilot scoping thread — need to lock success criteria, timeline, and the evaluation kit we hand to the customer.
Samir Gupta: thanks — quick proposal: 3 focused use cases, a 50-example golden set per use case, automated scorecard + manual review. Pass = >=90% on intent + <=10% hallucination rate.
Maggie Chen: copy — customer flagged pricing sensitivity and an infosec questionnaire. We should map which PII/risk fields might appear in prompts and answers.
Samir Gupta: Agreed. For scoring I suggest: intent F1, factuality binary per item, latency median p95 target 200ms, and a normalized cost metric (tokens * model unit cost). Regression gate: any model push that drops overall score by >2 points fails.
Alejandra (PM): timeline idea: week 0 align and ingest golden sets; week 1 run baseline on current model; week 2 iterate prompts + quant/latency tuning; week 3 customer validation + final report. Is that realistic?
Ryan - Sales: customer wants a 4-week pilot but can be flexible if we show early wins in week 2. Also they asked about dedicated infra for data isolation.
Samir Gupta: for infra we can run the harness against a private instance or a hosted snapshot. infra-bot: deployment to staging-private completed (job 4821).
Maggie Chen: security items to answer in the questionnaire: KMS integration, data retention policy, access controls, SOC2 scope. I'll draft responses but need dev confirmation for KMS flow.
Samir Gupta: KMS flow: we support CMAK-style envelope encryption and can configure customer KMS in Private mode. I'll add config snippets to the README.
Alejandra (PM): prompt-set design — suggestion: split prompts into deterministic (direct mapping) vs. open-ended (creative). Include edge-case adversarial prompts. Example snippets: ```
# deterministic
Q: "Extract order_id from: Order #12345 placed by Jane"
A: "12345"

# open
Q: "Summarize the customer's feedback and recommend next actions"
A: "..."
```
Samir Gupta: scoring examples: intent match (auto regex), exact-match token scoring for deterministic, semantic similarity (cosine) thresholds for open-ended using embedding model. Store golden answers alongside embedding vectors.
Ryan - Sales: pricing question from customer: will pilot usage be billed at hosted rates or a trial credit for dedicated infra? We should propose a nominal pilot fee + credits.
Maggie Chen: flagging an enterprise blocker: they require a signed DPA before any PII ingestion. Sales legal is on it.
Alejandra (PM): owners: Samir = harness & scoring infra, Maggie = compliance answers + questionnaire, Ryan = commercial terms + stakeholder updates. Deliverables: golden dataset, scoring script, README with runbook, baseline report.
Samir Gupta: next technical task: I'll assemble a starter harness repo with three folders (deterministic/, open/, meta/) and a scoring script that emits CSV with fields: case_id, intent_score, factual_flag, latency_ms, cost_units.
Ryan - Sales: perfect. I'll sync with the buyer and aim to get golden examples by EOD Friday.
Maggie Chen: I'll start the DPA checklist and ping legal.
infra-bot: periodic note — baseline run queued (build 4822).
Samir Gupta: small ask — when you send golden examples, include expected answer and a short acceptance note (why that answer is correct). Helps the manual review step.
Ryan - Sales: will do. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
